## Who Juss Rayy is
Juss Rayy is a founder and product/systems architect building human-centered products and founder-controlled AI systems. Her public work emphasizes runtime verification, evidence and provenance, scoped authority, recovery and rollback, privacy-first product design, and real-path browser proof.

## Selected work
- Founder Control Room — public site: https://www.foundercontrolroom.org/ — source: https://github.com/jussray/founder-control-room
  Founder operating system for project reality, bounded authority, verification, release evidence, rollback, and next decisions.
- Se’kret Bip — public site: https://sekretbip.net/ — source: https://github.com/jussray/Sekret-Bip
  Privacy-first emotional growth and self-expression platform for teens and families.
- Chief AI — source/proof: https://github.com/jussray/chief-ai-machine
  Chief-of-staff intelligence and controlled AI execution layer built around authority, evidence, and proof boundaries.
- PromptOS — source/proof: https://github.com/jussray/promptos
  Reusable prompt and agent operating contracts that preserve intent, constraints, verification, and stop conditions.
- StoryEngine / L99 — source/proof: https://github.com/jussray/StoryEngine
  Creator product and execution runtime for writing, provenance-safe reuse, recovery, orchestration, validation, publishing, and observable release controls.
- Juss Beautiful Hair — source/proof: https://github.com/jussray/jussbeautifulhair-site
  Shopify-backed commerce work. Do not infer a stranger-ready storefront or checkout path until fresh runtime proof exists.
- Untold Stories — source/proof: https://github.com/jussray/untold-stories-storefront
  Commerce and storytelling storefront work. Do not infer a stranger-ready storefront or checkout path until fresh runtime proof exists.
- Goalfix — https://github.com/jussray
  Smallest-safe-fix workflow: inspect reality, isolate the blocker, repair one cause, verify the real path, and stop on evidence.

## Public evidence rule
Use the linked public site, repository, commit, pull request, test, runtime receipt, or verified artifact as the source for claims about current project state. A passing test is not automatically production proof, a deployment receipt is not automatically runtime identity, and provider acceptance is not automatically a successful human outcome.
